card.name: The letter g starting a split word
card.fires_on: The single letter "g" when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as garrison, gables, gait, gulls, gunk or gynecomastia. It follows a word like the, a few, their or leaving his.

modes.label: Garrison
modes.description: The letter g starting the word garrison in military or historical narrative.
modes.example: General Taylor was away with the bulk of his army, the little<< g>>arrison up the river was besieged.

modes.label: Other g-words
modes.description: The letter g starting other words such as gables, gait, gulls or gynecomastia in general text.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-start tokens, with no clear link to the g-words, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on a lone "g" at the start of a word that the model had to break into pieces, like garrison.
